column1: # Fuzzy matching covered element names only, and only for a query of one or two words, so a typo in
# a property, a family or an element inside a sentence declined the whole question. The speller
# corrects an unknown word to the one vocabulary word within an edit or two - element names, field
# names and the operator words - and only when the question would otherwise be declined. Each row
# below was declined; expect_value pins the element and property the correction must reach.
# The guards are the other half, and the reason the speller runs only on a decline. "more" is one
# edit from the French for boron and "sure" from the Swedish for oxygen (D47); conversation is full
# of words near element names. They must still be declined, and so must a question whose nearest
# word is a different subject altogether: "tell me about mars" is not "mass".
